name: Echoes of the Forge
description: The prototype weapon has triggered dormant threats.|The forging process destabilized old containment zones. They now threaten the region, and only a coordinated response can lock them down.

text: It seems the forging process disturbed dormant threats.
Dark creatures have emerged, drawn to the weapon's energy.
We must find a way to contain this power before it's too late.
completedText: Seek tactical analysis to find a solution.

text: The weapon you forged is both an asset and a risk.
To contain its power, you must seek the Seals of Balance.
They are scattered across three equilibrium sites.
completedText: Retrieve the first Seal from the Earth site.

text: You wish to claim the Seal? Prove your connection to the earth by defeating the Stone Golems.
completedText: Defeat the Stone Golems to claim the Seal.

text: You've proven your worth. Here is the Seal of Earth.
completedText: Now head to the Water site.

text: To earn the Seal of Water, navigate the water maze and face the trials within.
completedText: Navigate the maze and retrieve the Seal of Water.

text: Impressive. You've made it this far. Here's the Seal of Water.
completedText: Finally, proceed to the Wind site.

text: Prove your mastery of the winds by flying through the Sky Rings.
Once completed, the Seal of Wind is yours.
You have the heart of an eagle. The Seal of Wind is now yours.
completedText: Return to Thrain with all the Seals.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You have just finished @crimson@Echoes of the Forge@green@. You have gained 5000 gold and the Vanguard Armor Set!
